tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search kitchen compliance intervals by area, system, service type, or permit. Returns matching records with next due date and status.

tools.name: list_overdue_services
tools.description: List overdue fire safety and health compliance intervals — the ones that create insurance and inspection exposure right now. Most serious first.

tools.name: get_services_due
tools.description: List services and permits due within the next N days (default 30), including hood cleanings, suppression inspections, and permit renewals.

tools.name: get_compliance_summary
tools.description: Get the kitchen compliance summary: totals for tracked intervals, not scheduled, overdue with policy risk, due this week, and awaiting tags.

tools.name: export_compliance_log
tools.description: Export the full kitchen compliance log as CSV text (area, service, next due, status, chase history).
